title: Interpretable ML calculator predicts 5-year weight trajectories after bariatric surgery
summary: Trained on two French centres and tested on external cohorts from 12 centres in ten countries (10,231 patients), the calculator predicts individual 5-year BMI trajectories, assessed by MAD and RMSE. Numeric results were not read; the study is retrospective.
ai_technology: LASSO variable selection with CART regression trees
organization: Universite de Lille, Inria, CNRS, Centrale Lille, France

evidence.tested: Trained on two French centres; tested on external cohorts
evidence.unknown: Abstract cut before numbers; retrospective; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO variable selection plus CART builds weight-trajectory calculator after bariatric surgery

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
